name: pfsense-app
label: Network
description: pfSense router management — devices, DHCP reservations, DNS overrides, VPN and HAProxy.
author: TheBananaStand

sends.to: the pfSense box on your LAN
sends.purpose: The SSH credentials you configured, to the router you configured them for. Everything it reads — leases, reservations, DNS overrides, VPN state — comes back from that box and goes nowhere else.
